propositions: The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal fixture mapping (LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO keys) instead of the canonical single-project state {legacy_default: REB, projects: {}}, causing Jira to reject JQL queries for nonexistent projects.

The multi-project fan-out in fetcher._build_snapshot iterates over every key in projects.json and issues a jql_active query per key; when the first key (LEG) does not exist in live Jira, ACLI aborts with 'value leg does not exist for field project' and reconcile_once raises, failing the entire pass.

The corruption arrived via ad-hoc git commits (9f1b2cff98, 275bd7507e) authored with test-fixture identity on the live tickets branch at 2026-08-14T19:18-0700, 21 minutes before the first consistent Reconcile Bridge failure at 2026-08-15T02:39Z.

The bridge-state write path (projects_store.set_project/remove_project -> _write_record) lacks the unified store write lock, commit, and push that all other tickets-branch mutations enforce, enabling unauthorized ad-hoc hand-commits that bypassed the isolated DC rehearsal harness.
